tree: AI workflow automation puts an AI agent inside a workflow. The agent can read a message, reply or decide the next step, and the workflow carries out the actions that follow.
Teams spend hours answering the same questions and moving leads and tasks forward by hand.
AI agents handle the routine replies and decisions, and workflows run the follow-up actions automatically.
Each AI agent can run as a step inside a workflow.
Automatically reply, qualify leads, book appointments, update records and more — all with smart AI agents.
Use AI agents and workflows across your favorite messaging and email channels.
Use pre-built templates to automate your most common tasks in minutes.
Ask for reviews after order completion.
Follow up with new leads automatically.

. Their replies and actions reach customers through your Noxtill inboxes and records.
How AI Agents and Workflows works in Noxtill, and where to check
How can businesses use AI agents in automated workflows?

Add an AI agent as a step in a workflow: for example, an agent answers an inbound message, qualifies the request and hands off to a person or the next step. Noxtill provides AI agents for business workflows and ready-made workflows to start from, supporting AI powered business process automation across channels.
How does AI Agents and Workflows software help a small business, and what should buyers evaluate?

AI agents handle routine conversations and tasks so your team can focus on exceptions. When comparing an AI agent workflow builder, a business AI automation platform or multi agent workflow automation, check which tasks agents can perform, human handoff, channel coverage, guardrails and activity logs.
